changes.before: House Commerce and Energy Committee at request of South Dakota Public Utilities Commission
changes.after: Chair of the House Commerce and Energy Committee at the request of the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission

changes.before: Passed House 60-5 and Senate 32-2 (amended); House concurred in Senate amendments 67-0 on 2026-03-10; signed by the Governor on 2026-03-24. A prior review attributed the 2026-03-30 recording date to the legislative action log.
changes.after: House passed 60-5 and Senate passed as amended 32-2; House concurred in Senate amendments 67-0 on 2026-03-10. Signed by the Governor on 2026-03-24; the final session index records that signature in its 2026-03-30 entry. The act prescribes no effective date; 2026-07-01 is inferred under SDCL 2-14-16 as the regular-session default, subject to constitutional and statutory veto and referendum provisions. Later amendments, referendum effects, and current legal force have not been verified.

changes.before: Allows PUC to assess actual processing costs to public-utility data center customers seeking contract deviations or electric service agreements; applies to data centers with 10 MW or greater peak demand and includes digital-currency mining in the definition.
changes.after: Authorizes the PUC to assess a public-utility customer the actual costs of processing a request for approval of a contract with deviations or other electric service agreement for a data center with at least 10 MW peak demand; the definition includes digital-currency mining.

changes.before: Sen. Chris Karr; House leadership sponsor reported as Speaker Jon Hansen
changes.after: Sen. Chris Karr and Rep. Jon Hansen (prime sponsors); additional Senate and House co-sponsors listed in the legislative index

changes.before: Signed by the Governor by 2026-03-25, as reported by SDPB. A retained legislative-history search excerpt records Senate passage 34-0, House passage 60-7, Senate concurrence 33-1 on 2026-03-10, and signature on 2026-03-24 recorded in the action log on 2026-03-30.
changes.after: Senate passed as amended 34-0 and House passed as amended 60-7; Senate concurred in House amendments 33-1 on 2026-03-10. Signed by the Governor on 2026-03-24; the final session index records that signature in its 2026-03-30 entry. The act prescribes no effective date; 2026-07-01 is inferred under SDCL 2-14-16 as the regular-session default, subject to constitutional and statutory veto and referendum provisions. Later amendments, referendum effects, and current legal force have not been verified.

changes.before: Defines data centers at 10 MW or greater; requires separate electric-service terms so data centers reimburse fairly attributed utility costs; bars state preemption of local data center ordinances and resolutions; requires local water-provider compatibility determinations and semiannual water reporting.
changes.after: Defines data centers at 10 MW or greater; requires separate electric-service terms and reimbursement of fairly attributed costs, including departure or material load reduction; protects local authority to regulate data centers; requires water-provider notice and compatibility determinations, Board of Water Management allocation limits, and semiannual public water-use reporting.

scope: Reviewed source observations, classification correction and explicit unresolved facts; all IDs retained. No current-law census asserted.
